note: 0.1.4 version skew (lib/plugver.pm orphaned, V-1): when an update or uninstall replaces a plugin version, Claude Code writes <old version folder>/.orphaned_at (epoch milliseconds) and keeps that folder 14 days, so a session that loaded it runs on. The session reads the marker in its own copy's folder: present, the notice says `this session runs <own>, replaced by an install at <time>: /reload-plugins`, with no later session start needed (status, the resume block's measured facts, begin); beside a newer session start both parts show. Absent, or not a number: nothing changes. After /reload-plugins the hooks run from the new copy, which has no marker.
